title: Odd-level padding makes the root non-injective (CVE-2012-2459 shape)
description: Under v1.2 the last node of an odd level is duplicated before pairing, so a sample list and the same list with its final sample repeated produce an identical root. A conforming implementation should be able to tell these two inputs apart; v1.2 cannot. Recorded here so the behaviour is pinned rather than discovered.
expected_under_rfc6962: Distinct roots: promoting the odd subtree instead of duplicating it removes the ambiguity.
